name: Lacidipine
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 2 mg once daily in the morning; increase to 4 mg and then 6 mg after 3 to 4 weeks on each dose if needed

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors or inducers (itraconazole, rifampicin), cimetidine

serious: Worsening angina (caution in unstable angina and after recent myocardial infarction)

pk.excretion_renal_pct: About 70% as metabolites in feces; remainder in urine (not as parent)

sources.citation: Teva Nederland BV. (2022). Lacidipine 2 mg and 4 mg Teva, film-coated tablets (RVG 105980/105981) [Summary of product characteristics; text dated December 22, 2022]. College ter Beoordeling van Geneesmiddelen (Medicines Evaluation Board), Netherlands.
